evidence.text: Construct the four-dimensional N=1 supergravity potential using K(S)=−ln(S+S̄), K(T)=−3ln(T+T̄) and W=MP³(C−A exp(−a0 S)). Use its no-scale structure, expand near a dilaton minimum, and lift the approximate potential to ten-dimensional Einstein variables.

evidence.text: A BPS-like rewriting organizes the action into geometric, flux and gauge squares, together with additional curvature and dΣ terms. Vanishing squares supplies candidate background conditions, but the residual term must also have vanishing variation before equations of motion follow.

sources.title: Heterotic moduli stabilization with fractional Chern-Simons invariants

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction of the flux–gaugino perfect square is expressed through four-dimensional N=1 supergravity. For one Kähler modulus, K contains −log(S+S̄)−3log(T+T̄) and the complex-structure term; W/μ³=2h/c−C_H exp[−8π²f_hidden/C_H]. Stabilization uses Kähler-covariant derivatives of W.

sources.title: Gaugino condensation and SUSY breakdown

evidence.text: Use dimensional reduction and truncation: reduce on T6 and retain SU(3) singlets to obtain an N=1 toy action. In heterotic M-theory, include the leading internal-coordinate dependence and average over the Calabi–Yau manifold and the eleventh-dimensional interval.

sources.title: De Sitter vacua from heterotic M theory

evidence.text: Construct the N=1 supergravity F- and D-term potential from a cubic matter superpotential plus WOM=h exp(−T) and WGC=g exp[−(S−γT)/CH], where γ=GvL and CH is the hidden gauge group's dual Coxeter number.

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can realistic anomaly-free brane sectors be built without destabilizing closed fields needed for anomaly-canceling axions? Can explicit geometries, twisted-sector alternatives, or brane networks realize the effective constructions?

evidence.text: When does the fermionic Z4 extension impose global anomaly matching, and when is it part of a dynamical gauge group whose anomaly must cancel?

sources.title: Note on discrete gauge anomalies

evidence.text: Which discrete anomaly constraints follow intrinsically from low-energy physics, which depend on a high-energy embedding, and how are apparent discrete anomalies accommodated in perturbatively consistent string models?

sources.title: Anomaly cancellation in supergravity with Fayet-Iliopoulos couplings

evidence.text: Which gauge and mixed gravitational anomaly cancellation conditions remain physically necessary in supergravity with Fayet–Iliopoulos couplings after allowing finite local counterterms, and what does Green–Schwarz cancellation change?

evidence.text: Can a D=7/D=6 Hořava–Witten construction retain gauged R-symmetry and a positive scalar potential while canceling boundary gravitational, gauge, mixed and local-supersymmetry anomalies?

sources.title: An Anomaly-free Atlas: charting the space of flavour-dependent gauged $U(1)$ extensions of the Standard Model

evidence.text: Which rational, family-dependent U(1)F charge assignments cancel all gauge and mixed gauge-gravity anomalies for SM fermions, optionally supplemented by up to three right-handed neutrinos, and how can these assignments be classified and enumerated?

sources.title: Notes on anomalies, elliptic curves and the BS-D conjecture

evidence.text: When do anomaly cancellation and compact U(1) leave finitely many rational hypercharge assignments in generalized SU(N) × SU(2) × U(1) models? The principal case has left-handed quarks and leptons in SU(2) triplets.

sources.title: The UV fate of anomalous U(1)s and the Swampland

evidence.text: Do analogous restrictions survive higher-dimensional cancellation mechanisms, and how strongly do the four-dimensional bounds constrain massive-vector models with heavy chiral anomaly cancellers?

sources.title: Branes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a supergravity theory that passes bulk anomaly cancellation nevertheless fail because its required charged strings cannot support unitary worldsheet degrees of freedom?

sources.title: Constraints on discrete symmetries from anomaly cancellation in compactified superstring theories

evidence.text: Do discrete symmetries arising in heterotic compactifications satisfy anomaly constraints analogous to those for remnants of spontaneously broken gauge symmetries, thereby restricting the light effective theory?

evidence.text: Which chiral noncommutative gauge theories are anomaly-free, and can the automatic disappearance of mixed gauge and flavor anomalies be interpreted as a Green–Schwarz mechanism generated by UV/IR mixing?

sources.title: Implications of the weak gravity conjecture in anomalous quiver gauge theories

evidence.text: Can anomaly cancellation make surviving gauge repulsion too weak to satisfy conjectured gravitational and scalar-force bounds when a chiral theory contains many abelian gauge factors?

sources.title: String universality in ten dimensions

evidence.text: Can ten-dimensional N=1 supergravity with gauge group U(1)^496 or E8 × U(1)^248 simultaneously satisfy supersymmetry, abelian gauge invariance and gravitational anomaly cancellation, closing the remaining apparent exceptions to ten-dimensional string universality?

sources.title: Discrete anomalies in supergravity and consistency of string backgrounds

evidence.text: How do composite U(1) and discrete duality anomalies determine higher-derivative counterterms in ten- and eight-dimensional supergravity, and constrain consistent lower-dimensional string backgrounds?

evidence.text: Do anomaly cancellation and negative-definite tensor pairing imply an interacting fixed point? Two explicit gauge candidates remain unresolved here, while a vector-free isolated tensor is reported apparently inconsistent.
